In [1]:
# --------------------------------------------
# Principle Component Analysis (PCA) for SESUG
# --------------------------------------------
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from sasviya.ml.decomposition import PCA

file_path = Path("./data/").resolve() / "fitness.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

Automatic Graphics¶

In [2]:
%set_env AUTO_GRAPHICS=true
# os.environ["AUTO_GRAPHICS"] = true
factors = ["weight","oxy","runtime","rstpulse","runpulse","maxpulse"]
X_train = df[factors]
model = PCA()
model.fit(X_train)
display(model.details_)
# SAS.ShowMLA(model.details_)

Current models supporting graphics¶

  • PCA – Principal component analysis
  • LogisticRegression – Logistic regression classifier
  • Lasso – Linear regression with L1 regularization
  • SVC – Support vector classification model
  • Assess - Assess learning model performance

The customize_results() method¶

In [3]:
# You can set the global style using this environment variable
# GRAPHICS_THEME=light | dark | highcontrast | opal | midnight | raven | htmlencore | grayscale | monochrome
# os.environ["GRAPHICS_THEME"] = "monochrome"
%set_env AUTO_GRAPHICS=False
%set_env GRAPHICS_THEME=monochrome
display(model.customize_results())

The PLOT Parameter¶

plots = "none"¶
plots = "all<(sub-option1, ..., sub-optionN)>"¶
plots = "PlotType<(sub-option1, ..., sub-optionN)>"¶
plots = ["PlotType1<(sub-option1, ..., sub-optionN)> ", ..., "PlotTypeN<(sub-option1, ..., sub-optionN)>"]¶

Eigenvalue Plots¶

In [4]:
# Display only the eigen plot panel with no tables
%set_env GRAPHICS_THEME=light
display(model.customize_results(plots="eigen", include_tables="none"))

env: GRAPHICS_THEME=light
§ EigenvaluesPlot
In [5]:
# Display only the eigen panel and pattern profile plots with no tables
display(model.customize_results(plots=["eigen","profile"], include_tables="none"))
§ EigenvaluesPlot
§ PatternProfilePlot
In [6]:
# Display only the an unpacked eigen plot panel with no tables
display(model.customize_results(plots="eigen(unpack)", include_tables="none"))
§ EigenvaluesPlot
In [7]:
# Display only the an scree plot from an eigen plot panel with no tables
display(model.customize_results(plots="eigen(scree)", include_tables="none"))
§ EigenvaluesPlot
In [8]:
# Display only the an variance plot from an eigen plot panel with no tables
display(model.customize_results(plots="eigen(variance)", include_tables="none"))
§ EigenvaluesPlot
In [9]:
# This is equivalent to an unpacked eigen plot panel with no tables
display(model.customize_results(plots="eigen(scree, variance)", include_tables="none"))
§ EigenvaluesPlot

Pattern Plots¶

In [10]:
# Display a pattern plot using only the first two principal components
display(model.customize_results(plots="pattern(ncomp=2)", include_tables="none"))
§ PatternPlot
In [11]:
# Display a pattern plot as a vector plot instead of a scatter plot, along with 4 labeled reference circles,
# using only the first two principal components
display(model.customize_results(plots="pattern(ncomp=2, vplot, circlelabel4)", include_tables="none"))
§ PatternPlot
In [12]:
# Display a pattern plot as a vector, along with 4 labeled reference circles,
# using only the first two principal components
display(model.customize_results(plots="pattern(index=[1,4], circlelabel5)", include_tables="none"))
§ PatternPlot

Exporting Graphics¶

In [13]:
# Generate an eigen panel plot as a PNG image, 500px wide, at 200dpi, using the "monochrome" theme. The image is exported to /workspace/output.
display(model.customize_results(plots="eigen", width=500, dpi=200,
                                path="/workspaces/myfolder/output", theme="monochrome",
                                output_type="png", include_tables="none"))
§ EigenvaluesPlot
